acceptance.pointer_gate: claim first; exact claim readback; duplicate create rejected; event next; exact event readback; second CURRENT must remain exact v59 and exact blob 6591d0339d13959a02c69f9340a2c674ee37d454 before single-file update; final readback must be v60
acceptance.replay_rule: same domain-separated semantic-intent key maps to the same create-only claim path; an existing claim is DUPLICATE and must not create a second claim or advance a stale expected version

campaign.decision_reason: Retain chain-scoped semantic intent plus operation-payload digest, but replace best-effort repository search as the primary exclusion mechanism with a deterministic create-only claim path keyed by the idempotency key.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: A deterministic create-only Git path is a stronger branch-local exclusion primitive than stale code search, but it is not a database uniqueness constraint. The claim, event, CURRENT replacement, reads, and Slack are separate effects; the claim can be orphaned if later steps fail. Force-pushes, rebases, alternate branches, repository retention, permissions, and API behavior remain outside the guarantee. No cross-file atomicity, isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, lock fairness, or automatic orphan repair is provided.

probe.name: DETERMINISTIC_CREATE_ONLY_EVENT_PATH_BY_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_V5
probe.result: The first create-only write to the deterministic claim path succeeded and read back exactly. A second create_file call to the identical path was rejected with HTTP 422 because replacement requires the existing blob SHA; it did not replace the claim. This materially improves duplicate exclusion on one branch compared with best-effort search.

canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the immutable claim or event; append a compensating transition from the then-current exact version and replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
